items.headline: U.S.-Brokered Russia-Ukraine Peace Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Delegations from Russia and Ukraine convened in Abu Dhabi for U.S.-mediated negotiations, marking their first direct talks in nine months. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio described the initial sessions as very productive as negotiators discussed long-term security arrangements and humanitarian issues like prisoner exchanges.

items.headline: IBM and Microsoft Partner to Launch Imagine Enterprise AI Agent Platform
items.summary: On November 10, tech giants IBM and Microsoft announced a major joint platform called Imagine Enterprise to help businesses deploy and govern artificial intelligence agents. The initiative combines over 6,000 prebuilt IBM AI agents with Microsoft's cloud and security infrastructure to automate complex industry workflows.

items.headline: FIFPRO Unveils 2026 World 11 Roster as Messi and Bronze Break Selection Records
items.summary: Global football union FIFPRO announced its 2026 Men's and Women's World 11 lineups after receiving votes from over 26,000 professional players worldwide. Lionel Messi extended his record with an 18th Men's World 11 selection, while England defender Lucy Bronze set a women's record with her ninth career appearance.

items.headline: Media Investigation Accuses British TV Personality and Author David Walliams of Misconduct
items.summary: A joint investigation by The Guardian and ITV News published allegations accusing British television star and children's author David Walliams of sexual misconduct and grooming young women over two decades. The report was released after London's High Court rejected a legal injunction attempt by Walliams, who strongly denies any wrongdoing.
